verdict.rationale: Vercel's 'Postgres on Vercel' docs describe provisioning external serverless Postgres providers (Neon, Prisma Postgres, Supabase, Aurora) through its Marketplace, with credentials and environment variables injected into the project. Its own first-party Vercel Postgres is discontinued, and the database itself is a third-party service. missing for 10: a first-party serverless SQL database, documented direct querying from code without connection management (e.g. an HTTP/serverless driver or SDK), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query a serverless SQL database directly from my code with no connection management

citations.quote: Vercel lets you connect external Postgres databases through the Marketplace, allowing you to connect external Postgres databases to your Vercel projects without managing database servers.
Have credentials and environment variables injected into your Vercel project.
Neon is serverless Postgres built for the cloud, with autoscaling and instant branching.
